purpose: Demonstrate whether a local-lane worker compacts its conversation at the lane's effective context boundary and continues to a complete manifest, rather than dying at the boundary.

lane.boundary_source: docs/research/data/clive-effective-window.json and the corpus census of compact_boundary records

design.task: Read, one at a time in increasing stream.jsonl size order, the 40 largest run stream files under the configured runs directory; after each, append one entry with its run id, record count and last record type.
design.order: increasing stream.jsonl byte size; the 40 largest run directories by stream size

compaction_marker.turn_definition: the count of assistant records emitted before the compact_boundary record in this node's own stream
